Name: Combat Pets
Author: G3sila
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Pet follow you and fight for you in the mine![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]* Everyday your pets would follow you anywhere (number can be configured).[/size][/color]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49447/49447-1784756251-1308113770.png[/img][/color][/size]

* If you go down to any dangerous areas, they would [color=#ffd966]autonomously attack and knock away the monsters[/color] for you.
* Their power and health depend on your [color=#93c47d]friendship[/color] with them.
* When a pet is defeated today, they would still follow you but no longer attack. Health is restored overtime if not defeated, otherwise restored all the next morning.
* More features on the way......

* Support [color=#d5a6bd]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/color]. Not mandatory.
* [color=#d5a6bd]Translation (i18n) enabled. [/color]Feel free to contribute your language!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI[/color][/size]
- recommand mod  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48260]Pet out of my way[/url] so that pet would not block you when they follow you.

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Journal[/b][/size][/color]
